details>What am I looking at?

A leaky integrate-and-fire model. The visible fly is a procedural male mesh driven by BANC v888 motor neurons through a generated bone LUT (kinematic, not MuJoCo). FlyWire v783 is an optional overlay. Tagged sexMismatch: male-morphology/female-CNS. This is not a complete biological fly.

Kick FL tibia fires the front-left tibia flexor MN pool into the kinematic effector — no CPG, no walk cycle.
